A walking day in North Harbor

North Harbor is fictional, but its compact waterfront makes a useful guide fixture. Begin at the old signal station, where a public path follows the disused rail line toward the market.

Morning

Arrive before the market becomes busy and take the upper walkway for an unobstructed view of the working docks. The small maritime room opens at nine.

Afternoon

Cross the pedestrian bridge and follow signs to the community garden. Cafes around the square serve lunch without requiring a reservation.

Evening

Return along the lower path as the harbor lights come on. The final ferry leaves from the central pier, a ten-minute walk from the station.
